studioLead: Two overlays for the stream, filled by the kills and knocks AFC Capture and the debugger upload send. Add each link once as a 1920x1080 Browser Source in OBS. They update on their own, with no reload.
switchOff: The kill stats Live overlays switch is off for this event, so both overlays stay blank. Turn it on under Kill stats in the event's Basic info.
noPlayers: No two players have fought each other yet. Pick players once a debugger file or AFC Capture has sent a map.
sourceHint: The duel overlay shows only the two players you pick: kills and knocks each way, and the last events in order.
